verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting continuously evaluates rules and pushes notifications to external systems such as Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps and OpsGenie. That is outbound, push-based event delivery, but the evidence never mentions a generic webhook contact point or event subscription mechanism. missing for 10: explicit generic webhook contact point/subscription documentation, coverage of event types beyond alerts, payload/signing details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
